about: Poses for the realism score. Each is the exact spot of a licensed street photograph. Photos are fetched into Saved/Realism/photos for scoring and are never committed (links only).

poses.name: lummus
poses.notes: Lummus Park beachwalk and the Ocean Drive frontage. Pose, heading and time from the frame; field of view of the Pixel 8 main camera (6.9 mm). The Godot taste test of 10 November 2026 used the same pose.

poses.name: dragon
poses.notes: US 129 Tail of the Dragon, a curve near Deals Gap, 18 April 2006 14:09 EDT. Canon EOS Digital Rebel XT at 75 mm (APS-C): 16.8 deg across. Heading estimated from the road; refine by capture. Placed on US 129 at its nearest point to the geotag (67 m away), looking along the road.

poses.name: bixby
poses.notes: CA-1 Big Sur, Bixby Creek Bridge from the viewpoint to the south, 17 July 2016 13:31 PDT. Canon EOS 6D at 70 mm: 28.8 deg across.
